text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the designation of a school bus loading zone on the east side of Ladysmith Avenue, adjacent to Greenwood School, located at 24 Mountjoy Avenue, to provide a safe pick-up/drop-off area for students. This designation will result in loss of five on-street parking spaces on Ladysmith Avenue during the weekday, daytime periods.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the Item until its May 24, 2023 meeting.
